Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with an inhibitor mechanism of action. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism and target_dictionary. Include canonical SMILES via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target ChEMBL ID as target_chembl_id, and target name as target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
